newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CYCLING-CIPOLLINI CLAIMS SECOND STAGE WIN IN SUCCESSION.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-CIPOLLINI CLAIMS SECOND STAGE WIN IN SUCCESSION.

text.p: Italy's Mario Cipollini overcame a snow storm and a tightly bunched field to win the weather-shortened third stage of the Tour of Romandie on Friday.
Cipollini was timed at four hours 36 minutes 40 seconds around the 161 kilometre stage from Estavayer-le-lac to Monthey that had shortened 10km because of the bad weather.
The Italian outsprinted Jan Svorada of the Czech Republic and compatriot Massimo Strazzer, who finished third, to claim his second straight stage win.
Erik Breukink of the Netherlands snatched the green leader's jersey from Britain's Chris Boardman who had worn it since winning the prologue on Tuesday.
